information: * The main event of this competition is **3x3 Blindfolded**. * This is a quiet events competition. If you are a new competitor, this is probably not for you. * Please have a look at the **Registration requirements** field and other tabs. ![Eesti kuubik](https://i.imgur.com/Cr7XSizt.png) * If a competitor takes longer than 1 hour combined for 4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded then they are not permitted to compete in 3x3x3 with feet.
